sentences.text:
Application (Appeal) No. 407/2026 Banshi S/o Mohan Lal, Aged About 21 Years, R/o Dachki,
Jaswantpura, Police Station Sadar, District Dungarpur (Raj.).

(Petitioner Lodged At Dist. Jail Udaipur)
 ----Petitione  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Bhagat Dadhich.
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Rajesh Bhati, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINIT KUMAR MATHUR HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE CHANDRA SHEKHAR SHARMA Order 05/03/2026 1.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant-applicant.

2. The present application has been filed by the applicant- appellant under Section 389 of the Cr.P.C. (430 of BNSS-2023) seeking suspension of sentence awarded to him by the learned Special Judge, POCSO Act, Dungarpur in Sessions Case No.95/2023 vide judgment dated 15.02.2025,
whereby the applicant-appellant has been convicted for the offences under Sections 451, 376(D),
376(D)(A) of IPC and Section 5(Ch)/6 of POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant-applicant submits that marriage of cousin sister of the applicant is to be solemnized on 10.03.2026.

He submits that the sentence awarded to the applicant may be temporarily suspended so that the applicant may (Uploaded on 06/03/2026 at 03:57:17 PM)
[2026:RJ-JD:10813-DB] (2 of 2) [SOSA-407/2026] attend the marriage ceremonies of his cousin sister.
He very fairly submits that there are other members in the family of his cousin sister to perform her marital rights but his presence is also necessary.

Banshi vs State Of Rajasthan ... on 5 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165849306/
1

4. Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the application preferred by the applicant seeking interim suspension of sentence on account of the fact that other members of the family are there to attend the marital right of his cousin sister, therefore, the applicant may not be granted indulgence of interim suspension of sentence.
5. We have considered the submissions made at the bar and have gone through the relevant record of the case.

6. Having considered the facts noticed above, we are not inclined to grant interim suspension of sentence to the appellant- applicant to attend marriage of his cousin sister, particularly when other members are present to attend the marriage.
8. The present interim application for suspension of sentence is, therefore, dismissed.

(CHANDRA SHEKHAR SHARMA),J (VINIT KUMAR MATHUR),J 36-AnilSingh/-
(Uploaded on 06/03/2026 at 03:57:17 PM)
